analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter compatibility issues when trying to install older versions of [product_name] on Windows 7. There is a common expectation for backward compatibility or straightforward upgrade options, but only newer software releases officially support the updated OS. The absence of support for legacy versions causes frustration and uncertainty, especially for those with older hardware or software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to be installable and usable on Windows 7, or for [company_name] to provide an official upgrade path or compatibility solution.
